Downloads

To take payments, pair the POS app on an NFC phone with a Card 4.0 merchant till.

POS app for Android

Version 1.1.0, build 8. This signed APK includes the offline payment core for arm64-v8a and x86_64.

Download the Android APK · Verify the SHA-256 checksum

Use the APK for a fresh install or to update a copy from this GitHub release channel. If you installed POS from Google Play, get updates through Play so Android recognizes the signing certificate and keeps your app data. At the 0.1.0 till release, Google Play listed POS 1.0.0.

The iPhone beta is on TestFlight. The public invitation does not list a build number. Check that your app offers Review top-up before issuing a new fee-inclusive invoice.

Merchant till

Till 0.1.0 accepts Card 4.x. It supports Bitcoin mint v1 and v2 and requires a Card 4.0 registry that supports your federation’s mint. Keep a compatible till available for holders of older cards.

Before joining a federation or issuing cards, confirm with your registry operator that Card 4.0 is enabled for your federation’s mint. The till defaults to registry.fedimintcard.org. Choose the same registry in Setup and on the till.

Docker

The image ghcr.io/fedimintcard/till:0.1.0 supports Linux amd64 and arm64. Use Docker Compose to start the till, open its admin page and pair your phone.

Release notes and all files

Card Setup for issuers

Fedimint Card Setup prepares cards and approves tills. The Android app is on Google Play and the iPhone beta is on TestFlight. At this till release, Play listed Setup 1.0.0. Confirm Card 4.0 support with your issuer before preparing cards.

The store app offers the Test and Live registry choices. Ask your issuer which matches the till.

The first top-up

A new till can start with an empty wallet. The POS shows the card credit, the fixed top-up fee and the total before the customer opens the payment QR. One Lightning payment covers the load. Any fee left after costs stays with the merchant. The customer’s Lightning wallet may charge a separate routing fee.
